findings_summary.title: Result: the shipped @x402-lens/express middleware satisfies the whole lab battery with ZERO defects — 18 PASS / 3 DOCUMENTED / 0 FAIL across 21 sealed sessions. Canonical gate green end-to-end (402 → pay → verify → settle → deliver with the full event stream); no delivery without a valid payment in any fault session (undecodable payload, verify rejection, facilitator 500/timeout); upfront flow: failing settle never calls the handler (documented guarantee holds); authorization-flow settle failure matches the documented trade-off AND still emits payment.settle_failed; identical PAYMENT-SIGNATURE resubmission is refused at the second verify (honest facilitator, duplicate_payment_nonce) — exactly one delivery, zero new signer calls; grant bypass is never silent (access.granted/access.denied always emitted); a throwing sink never breaks a payment; the wire form is untouched (observer read-only); config surface refuses exactly the documented shapes and accepts the valid multi-network control; shipped CLI gates healthy against the live SUT. Verdicts are claims about the CANDIDATE (with its documented carve-outs) vs the lab battery, not about the x402 protocol or the @x402 SDK baseline.

Observations (nuances, NOT defects; both fail closed): (1) runtime payment.settle_failed events carry the facilitator reason verbatim but findings: [] — the SDK settle error does not expose the structured settle response under the keys the lens's settleFromError reads (settleResponse/result/body), so settlement_pending / settlement_failed findings render only via `x402-lens explain --settle` (engine rule checkSettlementVerdict is correct; the CLI snapshot test pins it). Non-terminal semantics (reason carried, reconcile-not-retry advice, no delivery claim) hold at runtime. (2) a flat facilitatorHeaders object is rejected by the SDK exactly as documented (D-17) — no facilitator contact, no delivery, process survives — but the rejection surfaces as HTTP 500 on the first payment request rather than a config-time refusal; the lens SOURCE comment promises early validation ('validated once here rather than surfacing as a failed payment later') while the README makes no such promise. Cosmetic robustness gap.

Methodology note (honesty discipline): the first full battery run produced 11 non-PASS sessions; a per-session fact review attributed ALL of them to lab equipment, not to the candidate — 8 matcher bugs (empty handler dict compared as !== 0), 1 replay-capture race in the lab client (replay slots started before the slot-1 header capture), 1 mislocated expectation (flat facilitatorHeaders is rejected by the SDK at request time, not at config resolution — the probe was moved to an honest HTTP session), 1 unaccounted documented CLI behavior (inspect exits 1 with the CORS readiness report on a cors-off server). Matchers/harness fixed, sessions re-run clean: 21/21. Raw first-run ledgers stay lab-local (not committed); the second-run fixture and per-session facts are the sealed evidence.
